The PSI of Parappana Agrahara Police Station submitted charge sheet against the accused No.1 to 5 for the offences C.C.No.6283/2023 punishable under sections 406,408, 420, 468, 417, 464 read with section 34 of IPC.
2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-
The case of the prosecution is that the accused No.1 worked as a Shop Manager at Pai Mobile Shop situated at Hosur Service Road, Konappana Agrahara, Electronic City Phase-2, Bengaluru who is doing building maintenance and handling the customer.
If a customer comes to a Pai mobile store and approached to buy a mobile phone on credit basis, he will collect a copy of their Aadhaar card, PAN card, and rental agreement from them.
If the rental agreement has expired, he taking a photo copy of the same and send the scanned copy of the documents to the accused No.2.
The accused No.2 changed the middle and last digits and dates of the the same and submitted to Bajaj Company for loan approval and then sold the mobile phones to customers for profit.
In the year 2021 the accused No.5 visited the accused No.1 shop and purchased the mobile in the name of Vidhyashree through loan from Bajaj Fin- serve Company.
Thereafter, the accused No.5 did not pay the installment amount to the company.

From the pressure of the C.C.No.6283/2023 company to recover the loan amount from accused No.5 the accused No.1, 3 to 5 were joined together with common intention planned the same and clear the said loan of accused No.5.

The accused No.1, 3 to 5 collected the Aadhaar Card of the accused No.5 changed the middle and last digits of the same and the accused No.3 submitted to Bajaj Company for loan approval through Likith Enterprises in the name of accused No.5 again.

The accused No.1 to 5 joined together records were created to show that TVs were purchased from CW-1's company in the name of CW-8 and CW-7's wife Mrs.Shashikala, Vidyashree, Naresh, Prashanth, Jayakanthan for a total of Rs.4,44,699/- got a loan sanctioned from Bajaj Fin Serve Company and purchased a mobile phone and sold the same to CW-4 and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.
